title: He Said 4–5 Weeks. It's Day 247 ⏳
lesson: Markets move on words. Your money should move on facts.
description:
Feb 28, 2026: US and Israeli strikes on Iran began. Mar 1, Trump: "We intended four to five weeks." We counted every dated, on-record statement where he said the war would end soon, was nearly over, or that a deal to end it was days away: at least 30 (Mar 1 to Nov 1). Mar 9 "very soon": oil fell from above $110 to the mid-$80s, bitcoin rose to about $69K. Apr 7 ceasefire: bitcoin +2.6% in an hour. Jul 8 ceasefire "over": bitcoin about $62K. Trump says (Oct 1) his 4-6 weeks meant the Iran nuclear threat.

Not financial advice. Entertainment and education only.

scenes.line: Four to five weeks. That's how long the Iran war was supposed to take. It's been 247 days.
February 28, 2026. US and Israeli strikes hit Iran.
The next day, Trump says: 'We intended four to five weeks.'

visual.name: Donald Trump · Mar 1, 2026
visual.text: We intended four to five weeks.

scenes.line: March 9: 'Soon. Very soon.' Oil had spiked above 110 dollars. It falls back to the mid-80s.

receipt.headline: Oil prices dive as Trump says Iran war will end ‘very soon’

scenes.line: April 7: a two-week ceasefire. Bitcoin jumps 2.6 percent in one hour.
June: a deal is 'two or three days' away.

visual.name: Donald Trump · Jun 9, 2026
visual.text: …upon signing, which could be in two or three days.

scenes.line: July 8: the ceasefire is 'over.' Bitcoin drops to 62,000.
September: the war 'will end immediately after our election.'

visual.name: Donald Trump · Sep 9, 2026
visual.text: This war will end immediately after our election.

receipt.headline: Trump says Iran war ‘will end immediately’ after US midterm elections

scenes.line: November 1: 'We'll put it away very soon.'

visual.name: Donald Trump · Nov 1, 2026
visual.text: We'll put it away very soon, one way or the other.

scenes.line: We counted every time on the record. At least 30 times, he said the end was near.
Every time, the market listened. Trump now says those weeks meant the nuclear threat.

visual.name: Donald Trump · Oct 1, 2026
visual.text: …4-6 weeks to get rid of THE IRAN NUCLEAR THREAT, and I did it in one night!

receipt.headline: Trump said the Iran war would last weeks. Now he says the media got it wrong.

length_msg: script is about 1:12, a 1:00 Short needs 0:56 to 1:05 (155 spoken words, need 117 to 137)
